title: A Parish for the Ledger
author: Jude Dunmore
blurb: Silas Winterbourne, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
